tasks.label: Debug with uv: context
args: import debugpy, runpy, sys; print('DEBUGPY_STARTING_CONTEXT', flush=True); debugpy.listen(('127.0.0.1', 5678)); print('DEBUGPY_READY_CONTEXT', flush=True); debugpy.wait_for_client(); sys.argv = ['main.py', 'check', 'context']; runpy.run_path('main.py', run_name='__main__')
